label: 4. To the apostle of rebellion lurking in the aby…

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: To the apostle of rebellion lurking in the abyss,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: heed to the bloodcurdling roar

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: of Guillotine De Mephisto.
I take it that means you want me to respond to your message?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: My apologies.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Old habits die hard, and some from my human days still persist.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It cannot be helped,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: especially when you have been bound to the Big O for so long.
What's going on?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This is the first time

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I have spoken with you

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: since the Harmonious Banquet was held.
Are you referring to the party held at Elysion?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The ceaseless wails of those offerings,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: they give me no peace!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehehehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Bwahahahaha!
Your main point is...?
Why exactly are you here, Guillotine De Mephisto?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It would appear

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Big O's sinister has not cleared from you just yet.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You require rectification.
Why exactly are you here, Guillotine De Mephisto?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The reason I am here

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: is to ask you to form a blood pact with the Grimoire,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: the one who exists to maintain balance in the world.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: However...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: In order to achieve that, a price must be paid.
And I suppose I'm the one who has to cough up the dough?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I knew that you would understand.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: It's said that a flower's bloom is most beautiful in isolation.
Are you asking me to create a new account?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: You might have to lay bare your raison d'etre.
I've entered... my personal information.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I look forward to meeting the great genius

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: under the inevitable wheel of fate.
I also followed your account.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: In this time of great chaos, I will cherish this moment.
It wasn't that big a deal.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: For those who break the oath,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: may they suffer the eternal torment of the crimson flame.
Don't worry, I won't unfollow you.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Hehehe...

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Until we meet again, I shall abstain from saying farewell.
